answer: A stall listing at full rate from minute one lets farms flood a market. Selling starts only after one 14-gram pearl is grown: 18 POA sits in 9 reef cells for 7 hours, each sealed by a 48-bit cipher from a fresh 160-byte work ticket. Peers recompute the nine ciphers in 1.4 seconds; one pearl unlocks one stall, max 3 per 12-hour window, so forty aliases idle 720 POA. A mismatched cipher voids the pearl and keeps the 18 POA locked 4 more epochs. If a 7-peer sample finds two pearls with identical 5-ms ticket intervals, 40 percent of each deposit goes to auditors and both keys freeze for 5 epochs.
